features: Realistic Surveillance Look - The MX Dummy CCTV Dome Camera features a realistic design with a flashing red LED light, giving the impression of an active security camera without recording audio or video.

Deterrent for Potential Intruders - Provides a visual deterrent for theft or vandalism. Ideal for home, office, shop, garage, warehouse, or driveway use.
Low Maintenance & Energy Efficient- Battery-operated LED light requires minimal maintenance, making it a cost-effective security solution without wiring or surveillance equipment.
1 PCS Dummy Camera - Each package includes 1 dummy dome camera, perfect for single-point coverage or combining multiple units for enhanced deterrence.
